name: Somali Current
scope: Northeast-monsoon southward Somali coastal branch from an OSW northern gate at 7 N to an OSW confluence gate at 3 S. Source latitude ranges are 6-8 N for divergence and 2-4 S for confluence with East African Coast Current. Excludes the northward flow north of the divergence, offshore feeder, eastward continuation, undercurrents and gyre circuits. No year-round whole-current extent asserted.
layer: Surface/upper-layer seasonal coastal reference geography; the source describes a shallow winter equatorial current, but no fixed-depth velocity axis is reconstructed.
time_convention: Northeast winter monsoon convention; not a simultaneous dated observation or an annual-average route.
source_locator: Section 4.2.1, printed pages 48-49 (PDF indices 47-48): southward surface flow reaches EACC confluence at 2-4 S; winter coastal divergence near 6-8 N. Section 4.2.2 distinguishes modeled coastal continuation and northern countercurrent.
source_citation: Schott and McCreary (2001), The monsoon circulation of the Indian Ocean, Progress in Oceanography 51, 1-123, doi:10.1016/S0079-6611(01)00083-0.
coordinate_selection: OSW chooses offshore coastal waypoints and nominal 7 N/3 S gates. Alternative endpoint combinations use the source-described 6/8 N and 2/4 S regional limits; exact longitudes are editorial. No source current-core coordinates or model streamline traced. Offshore display offsets avoid the coarse atlas land mask; this does not verify shelf-break or current-core position.
scenario_rule: Three source-range winter endpoint conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude shifts: 81 editorial scenarios, not empirical uncertainty.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Shorter winter convention, divergence at 6 N and confluence at 2 S.
Broader winter convention, divergence at 8 N and confluence at 4 S.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
